# Gorilla Coin Rwanda

> Rwanda's first community-driven reward and loyalty platform. Earn Gorilla Coins (GOR) daily, trade peer-to-peer with mobile money, and grow a national digital economy.

Gorilla Coin is a mobile-first reward and mining game for Rwandan users. Users earn coins through 24-hour mining cycles, referrals, social tasks, ads, and investments, and trade with each other in a Binance-style P2P marketplace settled via MTN, Airtel, and PayPal. The platform is fully gated behind authentication — only the landing/auth page is public.

## Pages

- [Home / Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in to start mining Gorilla Coins.
